req.title: Retrieve task by id
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /tasks/{task_id} with the corresponding task object.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers GET /tasks/{task_id}. I design tests using EP (valid id returns 200 with correct body), NEG (non-existent id returns 404, non-integer id returns 422), and BVA (boundary ids: id=1 lowest seeded row, id=20 highest seeded row, id=0 below minimum valid integer, id=21 just above highest seeded row). Each test uses the pre-loaded fixture data and asserts exact field values to kill constant, comparison, and boolean mutations. The in-process TestClient is used throughout; no live URLs.

preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 20 seed rows

expected: description == 'Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.'

tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app import models
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

tf = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.db', delete=False)
tf.close()
DB_URL = f'sqlite:///{tf.name}'
engine = create_engine(DB_URL, connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
db = Session()
from datetime import datetime
db.add(models.Task(id=7, title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=False, created_at=datetime(2025,5,22,2,41,54)))
db.commit(); db.close()

def override_db():
    s = Session()
    try: yield s
    finally: s.close()

from app.database import get_db
app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_task_existing_id_returns_200_with_correct_body():
    r = client.get('/tasks/7')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == 7
    assert body['title'] == 'Fix login bug'
    assert body['completed'] == False
    assert body['description'] == 'Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.'

test_get_task_existing_id_returns_200_with_correct_body()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
os.unlink(tf.name)
